ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels occupy approximately 85% of the surface area, with low-intensity dark pixels forming a defined perimeter and scattered focal points.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous white field across the central and upper regions of both lobes. Low-intensity black pigmentation is mapped as a continuous band (approx. 5-15 pixels deep) along the trailing edge and concentrated at both distal tips. Discrete low-intensity clusters are located in the lower-central region near the notch and on the mid-right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 55 degrees and a vertical depth reaching roughly 1/6th of the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the trailing edge. Serrations exhibit irregular pixel-amplitudes with more pronounced peaks on the outer third of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edge curvature transitioning to a tapered, slightly recurved shape at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, roughly circular low-intensity pixel clusters (potential barnacle attachment sites) are visible on the lower right lobe and near the right distal tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jaggedness and possible minor tissue loss at the extreme right distal tip compared to the more uniform left tip.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct vertical dark pigmentation streak is located approximately 10 pixels to the right of the median notch vertex.
